description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as “Untargeted” and “Targeted” over the years 2012 through 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. For each year, there are two adjacent bars: a blue bar representing “Untargeted” datasets and an orange bar representing “Targeted” datasets. In 2012, both the “Untargeted” and “Targeted” bars are very short, with the “Untargeted” bar reaching approximately 2 and the “Targeted” bar reaching approximately 1. The height of the bars generally increases over time; in 2022, the “Untargeted” bar reaches approximately 42 and the “Targeted” bar reaches approximately 118. The bars are arranged sequentially by year, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
